requirements.text: This announcement is open to all U.S. Citizens. This position may be filled through the Direct Hire Authority. All applicants who meet the qualification requirements will be forwarded to the selecting official for further consideration. Category Rating, Veterans Preference, Schedule A and traditional rating and ranking of applicants does not apply to this vacancy.
* Males 18 and over must be registered with the Selective Service.
* Must complete a Background Investigation and Fingerprint check.
* Must be determined suitable for federal employment.

**You must meet all qualification requirements within 30 days of the closing date of this vacancy announcement.**
